insights.title: Runs fall into 2 distinct shapes; the slowest is 5.0× the fastest
insights.explanation: K-means over each run's time composition and duration found 2 groups (silhouette 0.47). The slowest group has 47 runs with a median of 2.79 ms. It spends 44% of its exclusive time in ml_patterns::audit_log (+18 points versus all runs).

insights.title: 2 runs are unusually slow for their kind
insights.explanation: Compared with runs of the same shape, the worst took 29.31 ms against a typical 2.79 ms (robust z = 7.4).

insights.title: Run duration rose 3.1× from run 51 onward
insights.explanation: Binary segmentation over runs in start order found a level shift: median 1.00 ms before, 3.10 ms after (rank z = 6.0).

insights.title: ml_patterns::sort_items grows like O(n log n) in input_size
insights.explanation: Across 80 runs, a least-squares fit of exclusive time against input_size explains 89% of the variance (R²), better than simpler growth models.

insights.title: ml_patterns::Session #1 changes far more than other instances
insights.explanation: It has 40 versions while a typical ml_patterns::Session has 4 (robust z = 6.7). 1 instance(s) stand out in total.

anomalies.explanation: Median/MAD robust z-scores of log duration within each cluster; |z| ≥ 3.5 is an outlier.

changepoints.explanation: Binary segmentation of log run duration in start order; a split needs a Mann–Whitney |z| ≥ 3.5, segments of ≥ 5 runs, and a median shift ≥ 20%.

clusters.explanation: K-means over standardized per-run time shares of the top routines and log duration; k chosen by silhouette among solutions whose clusters all have at least 3 runs (or 5% of runs). Clusters are numbered from fastest to slowest median duration.

complexity.explanation: Least-squares fits of y = a + b·f(n) for log n, n, n log n and n² against each numeric root metric; a model is reported when R² ≥ 0.8, preferring the simpler one within 0.02.

deterministic_diagnostics.explanation: Bounded rule-based diagnostics computed from observed aggregate evidence; severity is presentation priority, not probability.

object_churn.explanation: Median/MAD robust z-scores of log version counts within each type with at least 8 instances; z ≥ 3.5 is flagged.
